desc: Which bronze tables feed the plan.

request.text: What are the source tables of this plan?

turns.name: Mei Chen
turns.text: Which gold table holds the cash by entity?

turns.name: Span
turns.text: The dashboards read 3 gold tables: gold_investment_report_holdings_monthly (Month-end holdings by entity in USD and SGD with the status of each value); gold_investment_report_cash_daily (Cash per entity per day, administrator view next to the trading view); gold_investment_report_benchmark_monthly (Portfolio return, benchmark return and the difference for each month, from recorded values).

turns.name: Mei Chen
turns.text: Which table has the holdings by month?

turns.name: Span
turns.text: gold_investment_report_benchmark_monthly is a gold table (ready for dashboards). Portfolio return, benchmark return and the difference for each month, from recorded values. Columns: benchmark_code, month, portfolio_return, benchmark_return, difference. It is built from valuation_observations, market_observations, benchmark_definitions, benchmark_components.

turns.name: Mei Chen
turns.text: What are the source tables of this plan?

turns.name: Span
turns.text: The plan is version 1 and is live. Data comes in from administrator, trading_export, manager_email. Raw landing (bronze, 2): bronze_administrator_positions, bronze_trading_export_positions. Core model (silver, 0), the clean tables every project shares: none. Dashboard tables (gold, 3): gold_investment_report_holdings_monthly, Month-end holdings by entity in USD and SGD with the status of each value., built from bronze_administrator_positions, bronze_trading_export_positions, position_snapshots, valuation_observations, portfolios, legal_entities, instruments, market_observations; gold_investment_report_cash_daily, Cash per entity per day, administrator view next to the trading view., built from bronze_administrator_positions, bronze_trading_export_positions, position_snapshots, portfolios, legal_entities, instruments; gold_investment_report_benchmark_monthly, Portfolio return, benchmark return and the difference for each month, from recorded values., built from valuation_observations, market_observations, benchmark_definitions, benchmark_components. Ask about any table or column by name for more.
